board.create('image',['data:image/png;base64,',[0,84],[400,300]],{fixed:true,highlight:false}); board.create('segment',[ board.create('point',[0,84],{visible:false}), board.create('point',[400,84],{visible:false}) ],{strokeColor:'#cbd5e1',strokeWidth:1.5,fixed:true,highlight:false}); var trackers=[ board.create('point', [0, 0], {visible: false}), board.create('point', [0, 0], {visible: false}) ]; stack_jxg.bind_point(refAns1z1, trackers[0]); stack_jxg.bind_point(refAns1z2, trackers[1]); var IS_RO_1=(function(){try{var _el=document.getElementById(refAns1z1);return !!_el&&_el.getAttribute("readonly")==="readonly";}catch(e){return false;}})(); var zones=[ {el:board.create('circle', [[100,235],30],{fixed:true,highlight:false,dash:2,shadow:true,strokeWidth:2,strokeColor:'#94a3b8',fillColor:'rgba(148,163,184,.16)'}),cx:100,cy:235,snap:function(px,py){return Math.sqrt((px-100)*(px-100)+(py-235)*(py-235))<=30;},occ:-1}, {el:board.create('circle', [[300,235],30],{fixed:true,highlight:false,dash:2,shadow:true,strokeWidth:2,strokeColor:'#94a3b8',fillColor:'rgba(148,163,184,.16)'}),cx:300,cy:235,snap:function(px,py){return Math.sqrt((px-300)*(px-300)+(py-235)*(py-235))<=30;},occ:-1} ]; var proposals=[ board.create('point',[133,42],{name:'Triangle',size:11,face:'circle',fixed:IS_RO_1,highlight:!IS_RO_1,strokeColor:'#fff',strokeWidth:3,fillColor:'#2563eb',shadow:true,label:{offset:[0,20],fontSize:12,fontWeight:'700',color:'#fff',cssStyle:'background:#1e3a8a;padding:2px 9px;border-radius:12px;box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.35);white-space:nowrap;'}}), board.create('point',[267,42],{name:'Carre',size:11,face:'circle',fixed:IS_RO_1,highlight:!IS_RO_1,strokeColor:'#fff',strokeWidth:3,fillColor:'#2563eb',shadow:true,label:{offset:[0,20],fontSize:12,fontWeight:'700',color:'#fff',cssStyle:'background:#1e3a8a;padding:2px 9px;border-radius:12px;box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.35);white-space:nowrap;'}}) ]; var INIT_POS=[[133,42],[267,42]]; (function(){try{var _v=document.getElementById(refAns1z1).value;if(_v){var _m=_v.match(/-?\d+/);if(_m){var _pi=parseInt(_m[0],10)-1;if(_pi>=0&&proposals[_pi]){zones[0].occ=_pi;proposals[_pi].setPosition(JXG.COORDS_BY_USER,[zones[0].cx,zones[0].cy]);zones[0].el.setAttribute({fillColor:'rgba(37,99,235,.22)'});}}}}catch(e){}})(); (function(){try{var _v=document.getElementById(refAns1z2).value;if(_v){var _m=_v.match(/-?\d+/);if(_m){var _pi=parseInt(_m[0],10)-1;if(_pi>=0&&proposals[_pi]){zones[1].occ=_pi;proposals[_pi].setPosition(JXG.COORDS_BY_USER,[zones[1].cx,zones[1].cy]);zones[1].el.setAttribute({fillColor:'rgba(37,99,235,.22)'});}}}}catch(e){}})(); function _encode(){ trackers.forEach(function(t,zi){ var occ=zones[zi].occ; t.setPosition(JXG.COORDS_BY_USER,[occ>=0?occ+1:0,0]); }); board.update(); } function _snap(pi){ if(IS_RO_1)return; var p=proposals[pi],px=p.X(),py=p.Y(); zones.forEach(function(z){if(z.occ===pi){z.occ=-1;z.el.setAttribute({fillColor:'rgba(148,163,184,.16)'});}}); var best=-1,bestDist=Infinity; zones.forEach(function(z,zi){ var d=Math.sqrt((px-z.cx)*(px-z.cx)+(py-z.cy)*(py-z.cy)); if(z.snap(px,py)&&d=0){ zones[best].occ=pi; zones[best].el.setAttribute({fillColor:'rgba(37,99,235,.22)'}); p.setPosition(JXG.COORDS_BY_USER,[zones[best].cx,zones[best].cy]); }else{ p.setPosition(JXG.COORDS_BY_USER,[INIT_POS[pi][0],INIT_POS[pi][1]]); } _encode(); } proposals.forEach(function(p,pi){p.on("up",function(){_snap(pi);});}); board.unsuspendUpdate(); })(); [[/jsxgraph]]
